title: Moments, Levers, Gears and Momentum Changes

flashcard_questions.q: The turning effect of a force about a pivot, calculated as force multiplied by the perpendicular distance from the pivot.
The fixed point around which rotation occurs, such as a hinge or fulcrum.
The state in which the total clockwise moments about a pivot equal the total anticlockwise moments, so the object does not rotate.

flashcard_questions.a: A rigid bar that rotates around a pivot and is used to multiply the effect of a force.
A toothed wheel that interlocks with another toothed wheel to transmit and modify turning forces.
